## Quest 3 battery issues, warrenty not honoured
I bought a quest 3 whilst in America as it was my sons birthday while we were visiting family over there, we live in the UK and returned shortly after. Within the year my son starting having a lot of battery issues with the quest, battery not charging or charging downwards when on charge, not holding charge, not charging to 100%. It was in warrenty so I spoke to oculous support and they said they wouldn't honour the warrenty as the quest was not in the same country it was purchased from. And just said 'sorry, but we will offer you £25 store credit as a gesture of good will'. Scam of a company.
